criteria.requirement: Add constraint.tables.AllowedTuples/ForbiddenTuples as real Constraint subclasses, with copied immutable row values, explicit variable-column order, shape/duplicate-variable checks and bounded max_rows preflight. Allowed tables filter support against assigned values AND remaining domains and prune only unsupported values in forward-check mode; forbidden tables reject exact complete rows and safely prune a single remaining variable. Support nonnumeric and unhashable comparable domain values without requiring hash-based membership. Empty allowed table is unsatisfiable, empty forbidden table imposes no restriction. Preserve original solvers and the earlier per-query independent Domain contract, including unary preprocessing without permanent model-domain mutation.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
